description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller OrderController that handles HTTP requests related to order operations such as creating, deleting, and retrieving latest orders.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: A REST controller managing order-related HTTP endpoints, including creation, deletion, and retrieval of latest orders.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order, returning an OrderResponse.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an order identified by orderId.

methods.name: getLatestOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of the latest order responses.
